searchText: Yeah, I think so. Vitalik may be able to hit merge as I think he actually is an EIP editor? <@!425279588009246720> you should be able too. Thanks, I commented in the agenda with the suggested topic and recent comment I wrote on the issue (more general DOS protection and decoupling of worst and average case performance when it comes to determining safe gas limit) Why do you call it bikeshedding? It's agreeing on a standard, and keeping UX and user security in mind. You said you think it's unimportant, fine. Other thought it was important. Why do you keep harping on how unimportant you think it is? http://phk.freebsd.dk/sagas/bikeshed/
